Build and maintain facilities here,
including the clubhouse and stadium.

Rebuild the clubhouse or add extra
facilities. Mainly helps keep your
players in good physical shape.

Upgrade the training ground or build
new facilities. A good setup makes
training more effective.

Expand the stadium in your home town
and add facilities so it can hold a
bigger crowd.

Rebuild the clubhouse.

set up facilities.

Rebuild the clubhouse.

of this remarkably populous town.

town and its fine surroundings.

Rebuild the clubhouse.
You can build a grand home fit for
a club with a worldwide reputation.

The clubhouse is currently being
rebuilt. Let's carry out further
rebuilding after this one is done.

=W/This is a clubhouse to be proud of
anywhere in the world. You couldn't
ask for anything better.=

too big for the town. Let's rebuild
again as the town grows, shall we?

rebuilt. Facilities can only be added

facilities. Ones you've added can also
be upgraded further.

Choose the one you want and press the
A Button to build it.

Adding a @Y/Speed Gym@.
It should be an efficient way to train
players' reactions and running speed.

The @Y/Speed Gym@ is well regarded.
Upgrading it will train running pace
and reactions even more efficiently.

Adding a @Y/Power Gym@.
Training builds strength efficiently,
for tougher duels and harder shots.

The @Y/Power Gym@ is well regarded.
Upgrading it will build players'
strength even more efficiently.

Adding a @Y/Tactics Room@, a place to
discuss training issues and solutions.
It will help players grasp tactics.

The @Y/Tactics Room@ is well regarded.
It can be upgraded to make tactical
discussions easier.

Adding a @Y/Buffet@.
Balanced meals for players should
speed up their recovery from fatigue.

The @Y/Buffet@ is going down better
than expected. Upgrade it to serve
even more balanced meals.

Adding a @Y/Lounge@, where players can
chat and relax. It should help ease
discontent.

The @Y/Lounge@ is well regarded.
Upgrade it further so players can
enjoy their time even more.

Adding a @Y/Massage Room@.
Loosening stiff muscles after training
helps recovery and prevents injuries.

The @Y/Massage Room@ is well regarded.

Adding a @Y/Pool@.
Gentle full-body exercise that should
boost players' stamina.

The @Y/Pool@ is proving more useful

Adding a @Y/Medical Room@.
Looking after players' health helps
prevent injuries in training.

Players trust the @Y/Medical Room@ a lot.
It can be upgraded to look after their
health even more thoroughly.

Adding a @Y/Sauna@.
Sweating off training and improving
circulation should aid recovery a lot.

The @Y/Sauna@ is well regarded.
Upgrade it further for an even greater
boost to recovery from fatigue.

Adding a @Y/Data Analysis Room@. Lots
of data will help players understand
tactics and formations in training.

The @Y/Data Analysis Room@ is popular.
Upgrade it to deepen players'
grasp of tactics and formations.

Adding a @Y/Games Room@.
A place for players to play games
together, boosting their condition.

The @Y/Games Room@ is proving more useful
than expected. Upgrade it to raise
players' condition even further.

Adding a @Y/Supporters' Room@.
Encouragement from the locals should
lift players' condition as well.

The @Y/Supporters' Room@ is well regarded.
Upgrade it to meet even more of the
supporters.

Adding a @Y/Hi-Tech Gym@.
Cutting-edge equipment should improve
many kinds of training effects.

The @Y/Hi-Tech Gym@ is well regarded.
Upgrade it further to boost a wider
range of training effects.

We'll add a @Y/Coffee Shop@. A place to
grab a quick snack or drink.
It won't bring in much income.

We'll upgrade the @Y/Coffee Shop@, so

We'll upgrade the @Y/Coffee Shop@ again.

can use it. Income should be low.

who want a meal at the stadium will
